text: This original move removes pinned ews/xml_struct git replacements, keeps ews_xpcom version 0.1.0 with interop, and records registry identities and checksums in the root lock. It also changes explicit syn features in the consumed macro manifests. The accepted root lock later selects ews 0.1.1. These are dependency and compiler inputs, not proof of registry resolution or a successful build; excluded per-crate integrity/provenance bodies remain bounded.
title: The EWS registry move changes source identity and macro build features
